paraphrase: McTaggart's bundle on change (1908), the conjunction of his two sourced theses: no event changes in its A-series determinations, though there are judgings and perceivings (STMT-MCTAGGART-NO-A-SERIES-CHANGE-BUT-APPEARS), and all change is change of A-series determinations (STMT-MCTAGGART-ALL-CHANGE-IS-A-SERIES-CHANGE). Not his whole metaphysics: the C series and his later reply that appearers do not change are not part of it.
